description: This file defines the CounterCaptureCommand class, a command-line utility for capturing and reporting counter metrics from Orleans grains in a distributed testing environment. It sets up an Orleans client, interacts with a counter grain to retrieve metrics, and logs and reports the results.

classes.name: CounterCaptureCommand
classes.description: A command-line command for capturing counters from Orleans grains, including setup, execution, and reporting logic.

classes.name: Parameters
classes.description: A nested class representing the parameters required for the command, including service and cluster IDs, URIs, counter key, and list of counters.

methods.name: CounterCaptureCommand
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the command with options and handler.

methods.name: RunAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous method that executes the command logic: connecting to Orleans cluster, retrieving counters, and reporting metrics.
